requirements.text: 5+ years of commercial experience with Golang
2+ years of commercial experience with Kubernetes
1+ year of experience in AI-assisted coding
Owns problems end-to-end: spots the issue, designs and builds the solution, and ships it to production
Can show business impact of their work with concrete results (faster processing, lower costs, fewer incidents)
Advanced English for discussing business tasks, explaining decisions and presenting results on client calls
Works full-time remotely and delivers without supervision
Onboards quickly and starts shipping in the first weeks

resumes.text:
Marcus Lindqvist
Senior Backend Engineer

Summary
Senior backend engineer with five years of commercial Golang work and a strong record of running services on Kubernetes. I focus on reliable distributed infrastructure, measurable performance gains and shipping fixes on my own initiative.

Experience

Senior Backend Engineer, Corvane Data Systems (remote), March 2021 - present
- Five years of commercial Golang development on ingestion, billing and reporting services.
- Ran three years of commercial Kubernetes operations, managing 14 production clusters with rolling upgrades.
- Built a sharded job queue across 12 worker nodes with leader election and retry handling, processing 4 million jobs a day.
- Identified a memory leak in the ingestion service, designed the fix, and shipped it to production the same week.
- Cut nightly batch processing time from 3 hours to 25 minutes, saving roughly 4,000 dollars a month in compute.
- Joined the platform team in my second week and shipped my first production change before the end of the month.
- Full-time remote role, working independently across three time zones with no daily supervision.
- Used GitHub Copilot autocomplete on and off for about six months in 2025 for boilerplate code.

Backend Developer, Tessaly Payments (Lisbon, hybrid), June 2018 - February 2021
- Built REST and gRPC APIs in Go for merchant onboarding and settlement.
- Maintained PostgreSQL schemas and wrote migrations for a team of six.

Education
BSc Computer Science, University of Leeds, 2014 - 2017

Languages
English: Advanced (C1), presenting architecture reviews and client calls.

Skills
Golang, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, PostgreSQL, Prometheus, Terraform, Git

- Full-time remote work since 2023, delivering tasks without close supervision.

Junior Developer, Brightline Agency (Manchester), 2020 - 2023

Go, Kubernetes, Docker, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Git, Redis
